parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type for the request and response messages. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese.

- **en**: English.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The user ID of the member to which the administrator switches the view.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The view type. Default value: 0. Valid values:

- 0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.
- 1: the view of all accounts in the enterprise.
> The actual value of this parameter is an integer in string format (such as "0" or "1"). Pass a string value instead of an integer type.
